candidates.change_summary: Remove the access-control require so any caller passes the onlyOwner modifier.
Check tx.origin instead of msg.sender, letting calls via intermediate contracts by the owner pass while direct calls by others still fail.
Withdraw a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the entire contract balance.
Delete the internal withdraw call so withdrawAll performs no transfer at all.
Use sendMoney to forward the entire balance via call instead of withdraw/transfer, changing failure semantics and gas forwarding.
Remove the require(msg.sender==owner) check so the modifier no longer restricts access.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw no longer moves any Ether, changing the resulting balance of the contract.
Transfer the contract's entire balance instead of the requested _value, changing how much Ether is sent out.
Remove the require(__sent_result100) check so failed low-level calls no longer revert.
Change require(__sent_result100) to require(!_sent_failed_guard()) is not applicable; instead replace the sent check with require(true) so call failures no longer revert.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so any caller can execute it.
Send 0 value instead of _value in the low-level call.
